name: Nadia Yala Kisukidi
shortBio: Franco-Congolese philosopher of Négritude, Henri Bergson, and Africana political aesthetics who theorizes creative humanity and decolonized universalism.
centralQuestion: How can Négritude’s poetics and Bergsonian creative evolution forge a concrete universalism after colonialism?

keyWorks.title: Bergson ou l’humanité créatrice
keyWorks.description: Reconstructs Bergson’s philosophy of open morality and creative humanity in dialogue with postcolonial and Négritude thought.
